text:
morgan: FYI — embeddings P95 jumped to ~3.2s after the v2-quant canary. Seeing user-facing degradations for short queries. Requesting fast approval to pin and roll back the canary.

deploy-bot: Canary health check FAILED for group=embeddings, version=v2-quant. p95 latency=3.2s (>2.5s threshold). 6/10 success rate on small-batch paths.

ana (oncall): catching this now, thanks @morgan. Any immediate mitigating toggle?

morgan: prefix-caching was disabled by the canary image; that seems to be the main diff. We can revert to v1.8.4 which had cache enabled.

jamal: I need a clear rollback command and a short blast radius note. Is this safe to run in the next 5m window?

tina: Risk: stateful cache keys — rolling back will repopulate caches, slight spike in load for ~2m but should be fine. No DB schema changes.

morgan: Deploybot rollback command: `/deploy rollback embeddings --to v1.8.4 --reason "canary p95 regression" --no-canary`. Alternatively kube: ``kubectl -n prod set image deploy/embeddings-svc embeddings=redwood/embeddings:v1.8.4``

iris: +1 from SRE for rollback. Monitor ingest and token costs. Please tag me when started.

sean: Can we hold off if we get two product approvals? Product impact is visible, but we should notify support.

ana (oncall): Support updated (incidents channel) and customer-impact flag set. I'm on monitoring.

jamal: I approve rollback. Jamal (platform) — +1.

morgan: Tina? final ops approval?

tina: +1 — ML infra ok. Rollback runbook: 1) run rollback command 2) watch canary metrics for 5m 3) if p95 <= 2.5s after 3m, lift hold 4) open followup on quantization test gap.

morgan: @deploy-bot please execute rollback: `/deploy rollback embeddings --to v1.8.4 --no-canary`

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Rolling back embeddings to v1.8.4. Started by morgan. Rollback ID: rb-202402xx-01.

deploy-bot: Step 1/3: creating patch rollout... DONE

deploy-bot: Step 2/3: updating replicas and image... DONE

deploy-bot: Step 3/3: health checks -> stable. New observed p95=1.9s (1m sample).

iris: Observability checks look green. No tail latency regressions.

sean: Noted — drafting release note: "rollback: embeddings v2-quant -> v1.8.4 due to short-query latency regression; fix and retest quant path before re-rollout."

morgan: Thanks everyone. Follow-up action: tina to run regression test suite for quant kernels and confirm cache behavior. Assigning to @tina.

morgan: Closing this thread, will open an RFC for re-rollout criteria. :white_check_mark:
